name: read_screen
description: Read the current visible Android accessibility UI. Use before interacting when screen state matters.

name: click_text
description: Click a visible control by matching text or content description.

name: long_click
description: Long press a visible UI control by text or content description.

name: type_text
description: Type text into an editable field. Target is optional and identifies the field by visible text or content description.

name: scroll
description: Scroll a visible scrollable container up or down.

name: open_app
description: Launch an installed Android app by package name.

name: get_device_status
description: Return device, battery, screen and automation status.

name: send_notification
description: Send a local notification on this phone.

name: schedule_task
description: Schedule a one-time or natural-language recurring local task. Examples: tomorrow at 08:00; in 30 minutes; every day at 09:00; every 30 minutes.

name: schedule_cron
description: Schedule a recurring local automation using standard five-field cron: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week.

name: cancel_task
description: Cancel a local scheduled task by id or exact title.
